cd /app/work && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import gen2, check as C
from collections import Counter
import numpy as np
for tight in (1.0, 0.999, 1.001, 0.5, 2.0, 0.05):
    reqs=[gen2.gen(900000+i, budget_mode="huge", tight=tight) for i in range(150)]
    data="".join(json.dumps(r)+"\n" for r in reqs).encode()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/planner.py'],input=data,capture_output=True)
    lines=p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
    c=Counter(); mlus=[]; bad=0
    for i,r in enumerate(reqs):
        L=C.build(r); resp=json.loads(lines[i])
        try:
            st,val=C.check_response(r,resp,L); c[st]+=1
            if st=="optimal": mlus.append(val)
        except Exception as e:
            bad+=1; print("  FAIL",tight,i,repr(e))
    print("tight",tight, dict(c), "bad",bad, "mlu range", (round(min(mlus),6), round(max(mlus),6)) if mlus else None)
PYEOF
